root_cause.text: The zram discard path in `zram_bio_discard()` returned early for partial discard requests without calling `bio_endio()`, leaving the submitting task stuck waiting in `submit_bio_wait()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (n <= (PAGE_SIZE - offset)) return;` to `goto end_bio;` and adds an `end_bio:` label that calls `bio_endio(bio)`, while the CVE description states that zram “doesn't support partial discards” and “we forget to endio on our way out, so blkdiscard sleeps forever in submit_bio_wait().”

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The zram discard path in `zram_bio_discard()` returned early for partial discard requests without calling `bio_endio()`, leaving the submitting task stuck waiting in `submit_bio_wait()`.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes `if (n <= (PAGE_SIZE - offset)) return;` to `goto end_bio;` and adds an `end_bio:` label that calls `bio_endio(bio)`, while the CVE description states that zram “doesn't support partial discards” and “we forget to endio on our way out, so blkdiscard sleeps forever in submit_bio_wait().”

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure zram discard requests that end within the first partial page still follow the normal bio completion path.
intent_record.what: In zram_bio_discard(), the early return inside the `if (offset)` block was changed from `return;` to `goto end_bio;` when `n <= (PAGE_SIZE - offset)`.
intent_record.how: This preserves the function's cleanup/end-of-bio path instead of exiting immediately from the function when the discard range fits entirely within the remaining bytes of the current page. It prevents skipping any trailing completion logic associated with the `end_bio` label.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a shared end-of-bio label in zram discard handling to support correct common completion flow.
intent_record.what: A new label `end_bio:` was inserted immediately before the existing `bio_endio(bio);` call in `zram_bio_discard(struct zram *zram, struct bio *bio)`. No other code in the hunk changed.
intent_record.how: This adds a jump target so that any earlier control-flow path in the function can branch to the common bio completion point. At runtime, it enables the function to exit through a single `bio_endio()` path instead of duplicating the completion call or falling through from multiple places.

grouping_result.intent: Add a shared end-of-bio label in zram discard handling to support correct common completion flow.

consistency_review.core_intent: Unify zram discard completion handling so requests follow a shared end-of-bio path, including cases ending in the first partial page.

relevance_review.reason: The changes directly address the root cause: partial zram discard requests were returning early without bio_endio(), and this group explicitly unifies discard completion so even first-partial-page cases go through the normal end-of-bio path.

candidates.rationale: This condition identifies the partial-discard case that terminates early. When it is true, the function returns without reaching bio_endio(), which leaves submit_bio_wait() blocked.
This early return is the direct cause of the missing bio completion for partial discard requests, so the submitting task never gets woken.

vuln_statements.explanation: This conditional selects the partial-discard case that exits the discard path before bio_endio() is reached, causing submit_bio_wait() to block indefinitely.
This early return is the direct bug: it skips bio_endio() for partial discard requests, leaving the submitting task waiting without completion notification.
